description: This PHP class 'CalendarEventQuery' provides a way to construct and manage queries for retrieving calendar events with optional filters such as start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit. It includes methods for setting parameters, converting the query to an array or string, and validation logic in the constructor.

classes.name: CalendarEventQuery
classes.description: A class to build and represent calendar event retrieval queries with optional filters and utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the query with optional start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit, with validation.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for the number of results.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the query parameters into an associative array.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the query for logging.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Magic method to convert the object to a string, calls toString().
